svg.title: News
svg.desc: Trace Bloom section banner for News on lifehacker.dev. Every hack, honest tool review, and field note — the whole newsroom in one place. A manhattan lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Fallback cover for any post or page on the site that carries no banner of its own — the last fallback. Seed 4243967698.
